problem.h2: Your next client has already looked at your profile.
problem.body: Before they reply to your message, accept your invitation or book a call, they check who you are. If your headline is vague and your About section sounds like everyone else's, they decide in seconds. Not because you lack talent, but because nothing shows it.
problem.closingLine: You're great at what you do. Does your profile show it?

shift.h2: From vague to clear in one line.
shift.body: Your headline is the first thing people read. It should say who you help and what changes for them.

process.step1: A 30-minute call. We talk about what you do and who you want to reach. Before we speak, I review your profile.
process.step2: Week one: a clear profile. Your headline, About section and banner, rewritten so people understand what you do in seconds.
process.step3: Then: content that sounds like you. I find the topics, write the posts, design the visuals and schedule them. You give me feedback directly, as often as you need.
process.step4: Every month: what worked. A short report on what performs, so the next month is better than the last.

faq.a1: Helia Studio, run by Héléna Clinckart, writes and designs LinkedIn content for founders and professionals, and rebuilds their profiles so it is clear what they do and who they help.
faq.q2: Who will actually do the work?
faq.a2: I do. I write, design, schedule and publish everything myself. There is no team and no middleman, and you give your feedback directly to me.
faq.q3: Will the posts sound like me?
faq.a3: That is the goal. I find relevant topics and write posts that sound like you, and you tell me directly what to change until they do.
faq.q4: Do you write in English and French?
faq.a4: Yes. I work in both languages. The Trust Engine can cover both, at 14 posts a week.
faq.a5: Founders, consultants, coaches, advisors and independent professionals: anyone whose next client checks their LinkedIn before getting in touch.
faq.q6: What happens on the discovery call?
faq.a6: It lasts 30 minutes. We talk about what you do and who you want to reach, I tell you where your profile stands, and we see whether I am the right fit. I review your profile before we speak.
faq.a7: The Trust Engine starts with 3 months, then you can cancel anytime. The Profile Blueprint is a one-time purchase.
faq.a8: No one can honestly guarantee reach or clients on LinkedIn. What I control is clarity and consistency: a profile that explains what you do, and content that shows what you know.
